title: Zesty Ethiopian Chickpeas Stew
description: A vibrant one-pot stew with chickpeas, tomatoes, and a punch of berbere spice, finished with lemon and fresh cilantro for a bright, aromatic finish.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a fondue pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add berbere spice and stir for 30 seconds to release flavors.
Pour in diced tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they start to soften.
Add cooked chickpeas, vegetable broth, and coconut milk, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt to taste and stir in fresh lemon juice.
Remove from heat and let it sit for 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Enjoy the zesty, aromatic flavors of Ethiopia with this quick one-pot meal.
